voice.en: Right now, a buyer in Paris is looking for a home in Tel Aviv.
Another in London. Another in Ra'anana.
You can build a beautiful render. You can buy ads.
Every developer does.
We checked the live project pages of twelve leading Israeli developers.
Ten stop at the render and a form.
None lets the buyer step inside and pick his floor.
What no one sells you is all of it, working together, on one buyer.
Your marketing department runs the campaign.
We are the special unit you send in for one mission: bringing you buyers who are ready to sign.
When he searches in his own language, he finds your project.
On Google, and inside the answers of ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude.
We know how to put you there.
He doesn't just look at a render. He lands inside it.
He picks the floor. He sees his view.
He furnishes the apartment and leaves his notes.
He can walk the neighbourhood as it will be, after your building is built.
And we're now taking it into V R, inside the apartment.
Prices, the neighbourhood, the numbers.
A complete decision room for your project.
These are real buyers. Israel. The UK. France. Australia.
Checking the area, the maps, the renders.
Choosing, and reaching out.
One tap opens a live video meeting inside the project page.
Your team, the buyer, his family, anyone he wants to bring, looking at the same floor plan together.
You don't get a name and a phone number.
Floor twenty-three. Sea view. In French.
This isn't a lead. It's a buyer who already knows what he's buying.
From there, our team stays with him all the way to the signed contract.
We don't let him slip away.
The big money is abroad right now. We're there.
And we're here, in Israel.
Pick your markets, your buyers, your budget.
Your campaign can be live in seven days.
More buyers. Bigger budgets. Your next project.
nad-lan.co.il, slash marketing.
